message:
You know, I’ve always admired those folks who seem to have everything together when a storm rolls in. They’ve got their flashlights handy, extra blankets on standby, and snacks that could last through a blizzard. Well, I decided it was high time I joined the ranks of the prepared! 

I found this great resource that lays out some simple steps for winter weather prep. It’s not about being paranoid, just feeling a little more in control when the winds start howling. 

Now I’m not saying I’ll be hosting a winter storm party (who does that?), but at least I’ll have some hot cocoa and a plan. What’s your go-to tip for staying ready when the weather turns? ☕
